notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
Updated skull face's scream audio

Changed some texturing to make it less repetitive

Completely remodeled the entrance to the facility on Gren and Sotta

Camera flashlight can now stay on forever

Skull face takes more time to burn away

Remodeled the server room

A bunch of smaller things...



In the next update I plan to focus more on the minotaur and changing how the aliens react to light such as light from flashlights.
